answer: Proof of Personhood protocols utilize cryptographic identity verification to reach the summit of Sybil resistance, forcing attackers to acquire unique biometric data for each node. As the tide of automated agents rises, these systems treat every digital identity like a singular, non-fungible marble that cannot be subdivided or cheaply replicated. An attacker must bypass liveness detection for every forged identity, making the cost of creating a fake network exponentially prohibitive versus legitimate users.
